name: 46384-multiturn-4b-1gpu
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One in-process engine, no KV connector, no offload tier, no router.
architecture: Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration, bf16, 4B params, ~9.3 GB of weights, trained window 262144. 32 text layers, hybrid full/linear attention; a 24-layer vision tower is present and is never invoked by this text-only workload.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, both pinned to `mode: requests` -- 160 requests, twenty whole conversations, at each end. 1600 requests bounded, safety_seconds 1800.
workload: Multi-turn chat, text only: 200 conversations of 8 user turns, 1600 requests. Each conversation opens with a 2000-token system context drawn from one of 4 distinct contexts, then runs eight user turns of 200 tokens; every turn generates exactly 1 token and re-sends the whole conversation so far. Greedy (temperature 0.0), so output length is exact. Rendered turns run from about 2214 tokens at the first to at most 3692 at the eighth.
purpose: A 4B chat assistant running eight-turn conversations from four standing briefings, one request in flight, on one GPU.
launch:
# 46384-multiturn-4b-1gpu -- the launch config, in `vllm serve --config` form.
model: Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B
tensor-parallel-size: 1

# The deepest turn of this workload reaches roughly 3.7k tokens.
max-model-len: 8192
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192

# Not a default: this engine does not turn prefix caching on by itself for this checkpoint.
enable-prefix-caching: true
enable-chunked-prefill: true

mamba-cache-mode: align
